home.text: Main menu Eatons Hill Hotel & Accommodation They say go big or go home - but we went even bigger, closer to home. Just 25 minutes north of Brisbane City, we've been bringing big names to the 'burbs since 2011! With the likes of everyone from Prince to Post Malone, you can expect the biggest names in your backyard. Eatons Hill Hotel is an award-winning venue across entertainment, dining and accommodation. A one stop shop for business and pleasure; boasting over 16 function spaces, 9 bars, a restaurant, kids playground, nightclub, gaming room, retail precinct, a distillery and a luxury 4.5 star boutique accommodation building offering a range of room-types catering to both leisure and corporate stays. Whether you're coming to watch your favourite band play, hosting a function, partying in the nightclub or staying the night, we hope you enjoy all that the Eatons Hill Hotel experience has to offer. accommodation.title: Brisbane North Accommodation - Eatons Hill Hotel
accommodation.metaDesc: Eatons Hill Hotel Accommodation in North Brisbane offers 90 lavish rooms, ranging from spacious King Rooms to luxury Sky Penthouses.
h1: Eatons Hill Hotel - Brisbane North Accommodation
accommodation.text: Main menu Accommodation KING ROOM KING DELUXE CORNER SUITE SKY PENTHOUSE Eatons Hill Hotel - Brisbane North Accommodation Inspired by the chic hotels of New York, the award-winning 4.5 star Eatons Hill Accommodation is a contemporary space which seamlessly merges edge and sophistication. The hotel offers 90 lavish rooms, ranging from spacious King Rooms to luxury Sky Penthouses, and services the greater Moreton Bay Region. The accommodation building is conveniently located next to Eatons Hill Shopping Village, offering everything you could need when visiting for an overnight or longer stay. Guests can utilise the 24-hour reception to book in appointments with various retailers, including restaurants, cafes, a hair salon, nail salon, and skin & wellness clinic. Guest room facilities include: - Room Service - Tea & Coffee Station - Fridge & Freezer - Smart TV - Iron & Ironing Board - Bluetooth Sound System or Bose Sound System - Multiple USB points for connectivity Breakfast is available in the Green Room. It is available daily from 6:30am to 9am on weekdays and 6:30am to 11am on weekends, for all guests and the public to enjoy. No bookings required. Located next to the reception desk in The Green Room. The menu features a variety of delectable items to kickstart the morning, along with barista made coffee, tea, fresh juices and smoothies.
